notes.title: 🎮 Update V1.02 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🕹️ General Gameplay and Mechanics Updates[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Goalkeeper bugs fixed.
[*] Shot power now automatically resets 3 seconds after reaching the maximum.
[*] Bicycle kick cooldown time increased.
[*] Sliding cooldown time increased.
[*] Ball push mechanic added.
[*] Rabona cooldown time increased.
[*] Ball dragging strength slightly reduced.
[*] Bicycle kick shot strength increased.
[*] Shot bar fill speed accelerated.
[*] Stamina increased.
[*] Goalkeeper can now be controlled with a special key to automatically catch the ball.
[*] Goalkeeper can now clear the ball with his foot without catching it in his hands.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329019/2df4e85c70b5f4f0d6acb1e2b5df6c3d21a52277.png[/img]

[h1][b]🎨 User Interface (UI) and Visual Improvements[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Visual icons for skills added to the interface.
[*] Skill UI added.
[*] Tab menu and team change interface text added.
[*] "Change team" button size in the lobby interface redesigned.
[*] "Add to wishlist" text added for the demo version.
[*] Avatars updated and new avatars added.
[*] Avatar images redesigned.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329019/a6017dab02f74ddff21a609d2a8d01bf272aafd0.png[/img]

[h1][b]🔊Sound Effects and Sound Settings [/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Walking sound level reduced.
[*] Character’s landing sound after jumping reduced.
[*] Applause sound added after scoring a goal.
[*] Special sound effect added for Rabona kick.
[*] Background sound effects increased.
[*] Goal sound added.
[*] Level up sound added at the end of the game.
[/olist]

[h1][b]🧠 New Features & Content[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] MiddleEast map made available in the demo version.
[*] Demo trial time increased from 2 hours to 3 hours.
[/olist]

[h1][b]🔊 ⚙️Game Settings[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Minimum match duration now set to 5 minutes.
[*] Wishlist reminder text added to the demo main menu.
[/olist]

💬 Your feedback is valuable to us!
Make sure to leave your feedback after testing this update!
👉 Join our [url=https://discord.gg/9SAvTnQmbk]Discord[/url]channel – Development is in your hands!
Let’s keep the pulse of street football together! 🖤

notes.title: 🎮 Update V1.01 – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🕹️ Gameplay Mechanics and Animations[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*] Some walking animations have been updated.
[*] Dribbling mechanic has been added to the game.
[*] Curved shot feature has been introduced.
[*] The ball’s friction value has been lowered to improve physics behavior.
[*] Camera effects while walking have been added.
[*] 4 new skill moves have been added.[/h3]
[/list]

[b][h1]🖥️ User Interface (UI) Updates[/h1][/b]
[list]
[h3][*] A costume customization menu has been added. (Characters are now customizable.)
[*] A “Coming Soon” interface has been added to the main menu.
[*] The end-of-game menu has been renewed.[/h3]
[/list]

[h1][b]👕 Content Updates[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*] New character: Yakuza has been added to the game.
[*] New costumes have been added.[/h3]
[/list]

[h1][b]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3][*] Some visual glitches on the ground have been fixed.
[*] Various bug fixes have been made.[/h3]
[/list]

[h1][b]💬 Your Feedback Matters![/b][/h1]
[h2]We want to hear your feedback to improve the game.
👉 Join our Discord channel and share your thoughts with us!
We are building a street football world that grows together![/h2]
